fields.notes: USB 2.0 is a wire-level + framework spec; no PDK / SDC / floorplan constraints at the protocol layer. Per-USB-controller integration constraints (PHY characterization, clock-tree budget, ESD protection) live in the SoC integration spec, not in USB 2.0 itself. USB-IF compliance program tests are described in chapter 7 (electrical) and chapter 11 (hub).

extraction_hints: Look for floorplan, area, power, timing constraints.
